steps.title: Independent validation in a different session, broker chosen, read-only adapter authorised and reconciling (CE-X-02)
steps.you: Open the broker account you choose from 00_DESIGN.md section 5 (Dhan or Upstox shortlisted), get a static IP from your ISP, and store the API credentials with aion secrets set PJ_strategy-factory__<BROKER>_API_KEY (never paste them in chat). Then write 'AUTHORIZE BROKER ADAPTER READ-ONLY <broker>' in a session.

steps.you: Fund the broker account with exactly the rung-1 amount (LADDER[1], currently Rs 25,000) and write 'AUTHORIZE REAL CAPITAL A <contestant> 25000' in a session. Record the funding with aion money-add.
